description: Defines the ExtensionMimeTypeGuesser class for guessing MIME types based on file extensions within Drupal, implementing MimeTypeGuesserInterface, with deprecated mapping handling and dependency injection.

classes.name: ExtensionMimeTypeGuesser
classes.description: A class for guessing MIME types of files based on their extension, supporting deprecated mapping configurations and dependency injection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MIME type guesser with a map or module handler, with deprecation warning for old usage.

methods.name: guessMimeType
methods.description: Guesses the MIME type of a file based on its extension by examining parts of the filename.

methods.name: setMapping
methods.description: Deprecated method to set MIME type mappings directly, now replaced by MimeTypeMapInterface methods.

methods.name: isGuesserSupported
methods.description: Returns true indicating that this guesser is supported.
